parents.course: Current Topics in Computing Education Research

ns2:section.sectionText: The course focuses on broadening participation in computer science (CS) education within the US. The course readings (approximately 60 pages a week) will draw on fields such as education, history, psychology, and critical studies. The course readings, writing assignments, and class discussions will help us explore current patterns of and causes of unequal, inequitable, and unjust access to and experiences within CS education. The course will provide exposure to both qualitative and quantitative methods used within CS education. No background is required in CS or education.
